Get basic information about review flag configuration for this site.

name
The key name of this tag.
levels
Number of levels the tag has (above "not tagged").
Flagged revisions have an assigned level for each tag. The highest tier that all the tags meet is the review tier of the entire revision.

globalblock.description: Globally block or unblock a user.

params.local-allow-account-creation: Specify this if the local block should not prevent account creation. Cannot be used together with id.

globalpreferences.description:
Change global preferences of the current user.

Only preferences registered for the current wiki can be changed locally.

params.reset: Reset global preferences. Removes all, or, depending on the value of the `resetkinds` parameter, some types of global preferences and make them not global anymore.
params.resetkinds: List of types of preferences to reset when the reset option is set.
params.change: List of changes, formatted name=value (e.g. skin=vector). If no value is given (not even an equals sign), e.g., preferencename|otherpreference|..., the preference will be made non-global. If any value passed contains the pipe character (`|`), use the alternative multiple-value separator for correct operation.
params.optionname: The name of the preference that should be set to the value given by optionvalue.
params.optionvalue: The value for the preference specified by optionname.

globalpreferenceoverrides.description:
Change local overrides for global preferences for the current user.

Global values for affected preferences will be ignored.

params.reset: Reset local overrides. Removes all, or, depending on the value of the `resetkinds` parameter, some types of local overrides and makes them global again.
params.resetkinds: List of types of overrides to reset when the reset option is set.
params.change: List of changes, formatted name=value (e.g. skin=vector). If no value is given (not even an equals sign), e.g., preferencename|otherpreference|..., the override will be removed. If any value passed contains the pipe character (`|`), use the alternative multiple-value separator for correct operation.
params.optionname: The name of the override that should be set to the value given by optionvalue.
params.optionvalue: The value for the override specified by optionname.

wikilove.description:
Give WikiLove to another user.

WikiLove is a positive message posted to a user's talk page through a convenient interface with preset or locally defined templates. This action adds the specified wikitext to a certain talk page. For statistical purposes, the type and other data are logged.
